hypothesis: A strong positive first-15-minute price response after a scheduled FOMC decision continues after a five-minute additional delay, beyond an event-day clock-only long control.
status_at_freeze: No H3 performance calculated. Rules fixed before event extraction; no parameter search.
event_definition: All regular FOMC policy-decision release days within the two windows. Exclude minutes, unscheduled decisions and notation votes. The Fed calendar and linked statements identify dates and release times; do not use statement content or revised macroeconomic values as features.
rule_name_note: Internal opening_drive_long identifier reuses the M2 calculation but here its input bars are the FOMC reaction bars, not the session opening bars. This is a new economic hypothesis on reused data, not an independent or blind dataset.

strategy.stop: Low of the three reaction bars; completed close at/below threshold triggers exit at bar-start + 10 minutes or next available regular-session open. No assumed stop-price fill.
strategy.non_event_sessions: No entries, but settlement, account drawdown and monthly overhead still processed. All calendar months are charged even with no events.

inheritance: Use the unchanged M2 calendar, conservative settlement convention, raw-bar validation and risk controller. Add only an optional active-event-date filter to the shared replay; verify default replay parity against saved M2 results.
data_provenance: Reuse all 36 Massive CSV files from the M2 snapshot whose data-manifest SHA256 is 8e99aa78c906e3346ab3ce1f23a661415c202ecae6112bfb798a1fecc09233b8. These histories and M2 results have already been inspected. H3 is exploratory historical research, not a fresh holdout. No October 2026 stock performance.
capital_interpretation: 36 alternatives, each starting at $2000. Do not add symbols or reset-window results into a portfolio. Costs assume a standalone account, not a shared-cost combination.
primary_metric: Net return and observed drawdown in each complete evaluation window, candidate minus matching same-event clock control. Report all 36 cases and calendar inactivity.
rejection_rules: Base-cost candidate must have positive net return and beat its same-event clock control in both windows, without observed drawdown above 40%, to justify collecting better execution evidence.
Even a pass is only a pilot with 8 and 6 event opportunities; it is not evidence of a stable annual return or deployment eligibility.
Report the contribution of the largest winning event and the result after removing that trade arithmetically, without resimulating later sizes. Do not tune or delete the event.
Only the complete 2025 window can be checked against +1000%; never annualize the nine-month result into achieved performance.
descriptive_control: For each of the 14 events, choose the previous same weekday 7 days earlier; if not a full non-FOMC trading day, move back another 7 days. Compare sign(first-15-minute return) * subsequent 14:20-to-15:50 raw return on the event and its paired day. This bidirectional price statistic is NOT an executable short strategy or account return. Report pairs, mean differences and leave-one-event-out means; no causal, significance or confidence claim.

nano_data_gate.checks: Each expected full regular session has 78 slots. Report missing slots, volume, transactions, low-volume bars and signal/exit-bar availability. Missing aggregates are not forward filled or automatically called no trades: distinguish possible inactivity from vendor omissions.
nano_data_gate.illustrative_costs: For ONE actual contract, assume $1 cash fees per side and one tick adverse price slippage per side. These are assumed all-in fees, not broker quotes. Evaluate stop-risk dollars and $20 planned-risk fit on the September 16 event only, for positive first-15-minute response; do not synthesize NES fills from MES prices.
nano_data_gate.capital_gate: Account-specific and historical margins, quote depth, receipt timestamps and permissions remain unknown. Passing the unit risk calculation cannot authorize a position.
nano_data_gate.performance_claim: No NES account return or annual return is calculated. One month after a recent listing cannot establish annual performance.
nano_data_gate.inspection_disclosure: Three midnight-UTC NESZ6 bars from 2026-09-16 and three midnight-UTC MESZ5 bars from 2025-12-10 were inspected for format/access before freeze. No event response was calculated. Earlier launch-day NES probe was empty; later September access succeeded.
